messages:
neel: heads-up — starting a tiny refresh PR for the quickstart 'pilot' flow: single-file hello app, auth guidance, and minimal docker run. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3890
maya: love this. can we make the sample token flow clear for newcomers? i.e., show tokenless dev, env var fallback, and a short docker secret hint.
eli: echo — also include a "what failed" troubleshooting bullet: common env var typos and how to validate (curl against /v1/health or print env at startup).
neel: added a short env-check snippet:
```bash
# confirm env loaded
node -e "console.log(process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY ? 'ok' : 'missing')"
```
maya: nice. can we also add a tiny SDK snippet that shows fallback to creds file? e.g.
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY || getCredsFromHome() })
```
eli: linting: code fences must use "js" not "javascript" per style. i'll standardize.
docs-bot: CI: docs build queued ⚙️
neel: added a dedicated note for Dedicated customers about KMS-backed secrets + how to mount as env during deploy.
maya: small editorial nit: keep the quickstart under 250 words and link to the deep-dive repo for multi-file examples.
eli: pushed a micro-commit that shortens the runtime tips and calls out when to pick quantized local images (rwd-3b-quant) for fast smoke tests.
pr-bot: PR #3890 requested reviewers: maya, eli
maya: reviewing now. one question — do we change the default seq_len mention to 1024 in this doc? that might confuse users on older Dedicated clusters.
neel: i'll add an explicit "cluster defaults may vary" note and link to the runtime config doc.
maya: approved in GH. :thumbsup:
docs-bot: Preview build passed ✅ — https://deploy-preview-3890--docs.redwood.ai
ci-bot: canary smoke checks in progress.
eli: pushed one more link fix (examples repo path) and a tiny troubleshooting table. merged once canary is green.
ci-bot: canary smoke checks passed. merged and scheduled backport to 2.1-stable.
